data.one_liner: Detects user inactivity or app background time and emits timeout events for redirection.
data.what_it_does: Provides SessionConfig and SessionTimeoutManager widgets that monitor user activity and app focus. When configured durations are exceeded, a stream emits timeout states that can be used to navigate to an authentication page.
use_when: The app contains confidential data and must auto‑logout after inactivity
You need an offline‑first solution that works on mobile, web and desktop
You want a simple, configurable timeout without adding a full auth framework
avoid_when: Precise keyboard activity detection is required
App‑focus timeout is needed on web or desktop (unsupported)
You need a complete authentication solution rather than just timeout detection
strengths: Works offline and on all major platforms
Uses a stream so you can react anywhere in the app
weaknesses: App‑focus timeout only works on Android/iOS
Keyboard input isn’t counted as activity
Must be placed at the top of the widget tree
